replacements.text: feat(acceptance-criteria): attack panel (reviewers) files coverage gaps by one rule only [9k9.405.14]

The acceptance-criteria standard's coverage rule asks whether a commitment has a criterion at all. The repeated coverage question in another rule's opening led its reviewer to file coverage gaps under that rule. That rule now asks only about the check a criterion names. 9 of 10 panel runs on the corrected control document now return an empty report, up from 2 of 10. All 10 runs on the defective document still object to the planted criterion.
The author's machine holds the run records behind the numbers in an untracked scratch directory.
Every specification reviewed by the panel with the deployed standard, in every project.
The owner, through a mistaken belief in a quieter panel.
Ten runs per document used the same model and effort. The one remaining control objection cites a flaw present in both document versions.
Run the pilot (the trial using a defective document and a corrected control) again.

The `verification-contract` rule (the rule for judging a criterion's check) repeated the coverage rule's question in its opening sentence. It now opens by judging each criterion's own check. It sends the other question to coverage.
The attack skill's table of reviewers gains a column naming each reviewer's reading unit. That unit decides rule ownership.

The `verification-contract` rule's opening asserted a feasible check for every material commitment. That sentence repeats the coverage rule's question. The overlap led the reviewer responsible for `verification-contract` to file coverage gaps under it. 18 of 20 runs on the pilot's second case raised such objections under the original rule.

Each reviewer in the attack panel is defined by its reading unit. One reads a single criterion for its own structure. One reads the set against the document's promises. One reads the set against itself. One asks a single criterion about omissions from its check. That unit decides rule ownership. Two reviewers may share ground when one asks about a criterion and the other about the set.

The measurement used the pilot's second case (a realistic document of eight criteria with one planted defect) and a corrected control. Ten fresh runs per document read prompts emitted from each version of the standard. 10 of 10 defective runs objected to the planted criterion under the planted rule, before the change and after it. 1 of 10 defective runs objected elsewhere, down from 10 of 10. 9 of 10 control runs returned an empty report, up from 2 of 10. The one remaining control objection cites a contradiction present in both test-document versions.

No reviewer prompt changed. No existing attack record is reopened. The record check binds to the document's revision, never to the rule text. Other sentences in the attack skill were shortened to keep its body under the size cap.
The `verification-contract` rule judges whether each criterion names a feasible and complete check. It sends the question of whether a commitment has a criterion to coverage.
The attack skill states each reviewer's reading unit beside its table of reviewers.
At least 8 of 10 control runs come back empty. At least 8 of 10 defective runs object to the planted criterion.
0 is the exit status of `make content-tests`.
feat(acceptance-criteria): attack panel (reviewers) files coverage gaps by one rule only [9k9.405.14]

One acceptance-criteria rule's opening repeated the coverage rule's question. The overlap led its reviewer to file coverage gaps under that rule. Only 2 of 10 runs on the corrected control document came back empty.

The verification-contract rule (the rule for judging a criterion's check) now opens by judging each criterion's named check. Whether a commitment has a criterion at all stays with coverage. The attack skill's table of reviewers names each one's reading unit. That unit decides rule ownership.

0 is the exit status of make ci. 9 of 10 runs returned empty control reports in the pilot's second case (a realistic document of eight criteria with one planted defect), using ten runs per document. 10 of 10 runs detected the planted defect. One prose review round came back clean.

questions.question: What does an attack record's fingerprint mean? The record explains why it changes but does not define it.
What is the attack skill? The record describes its table and contents but does not define this house term.
Please add a separate Heads-up row for the caveat that the remaining control objection cites a flaw present in both document versions.
